data.title: The chairs after the busy season
data.goal: The chairs after the busy season

memoryNodes.cue: The team discusses the busy season.

data.situation:
In August, after the school fair, Mina brought the chairs back to the staff table. Everyone had made a tremendous effort, but the shop was not suddenly a booming business. Noor’s longer opening hours had produced only a marginal increase in sales. Jay proposed a more pragmatic change: keep the hours, but use the quiet last half-hour to prepare the next day’s repair cards. Eli’s complaint in April had helped reinforce their habit of showing a repair before wrapping it. That small change had transformed the way Jay finished an order. Mina put a letter from the college tutor on the table. It was a testimonial describing Jay’s careful repair work during the course. He read the first sentence twice, then tucked the letter into his bag. To whom it may concern,
Jay attended our evening repair course from May to July. He worked carefully with fabric and handles, checked his finished work, and accepted feedback constructively. I would be pleased to recommend him for further practical training.
A. Patel, workshop tutor

readingBlocks.en: In August, after the school fair, Mina brought the chairs back to the staff table. Everyone had made a tremendous effort, but the shop was not suddenly a booming business. Noor’s longer opening hours had produced only a marginal increase in sales. Jay proposed a more pragmatic change: keep the hours, but use the quiet last half-hour to prepare the next day’s repair cards. Eli’s complaint in April had helped reinforce their habit of showing a repair before wrapping it. That small change had transformed the way Jay finished an order. Mina put a letter from the college tutor on the table. It was a testimonial describing Jay’s careful repair work during the course. He read the first sentence twice, then tucked the letter into his bag.
readingBlocks.zh: 八月，学校集市结束后，米娜把椅子搬回员工桌旁。每个人都付出了很大努力，但小店并没有突然变成迅速兴旺的生意。努尔延长营业时间，只带来小幅销售增加。杰伊提出更务实的改动：保留营业时间，但用清静的最后半小时准备次日维修卡。伊莱四月的投诉让他们更坚持先展示维修结果，再包装。这个小改变彻底改变了杰伊完成订单的方式。米娜把学院老师的一封信放到桌上，那是一封推荐信，介绍杰伊在课程里细致的维修工作。他读了两遍第一句话，然后把信放进包里。

readingBlocks.en:
To whom it may concern,
Jay attended our evening repair course from May to July. He worked carefully with fabric and handles, checked his finished work, and accepted feedback constructively. I would be pleased to recommend him for further practical training.
A. Patel, workshop tutor
readingBlocks.zh:
致有关人士：
杰伊五月至七月参加了我们的维修夜课。他细致处理织物和提手，检查完成的工作，并认真接受反馈。我愿意推荐他继续参加实践培训。
A. 帕特尔，作坊课程教师

glossary.note: a tremendous effort；本句是程度，不凭此断言生意成功。
glossary.example: Everyone had made a tremendous effort.
glossary.exampleZh: 每个人都付出很大努力。

externalEvidence.definition: extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree- Walter Lippman

glossary.note: a booming business；来源为形容词，不另按 boom/booming 计相同发展概念。
glossary.example: The shop was not yet a booming business.
glossary.exampleZh: 小店还不是迅速兴旺的生意。

glossary.note: a marginal increase；本句数量小，不是 margin 页边或经济边际成本义。
glossary.example: Longer hours produced only a marginal increase in sales.
glossary.exampleZh: 延长时间只带来小幅销售增长。

glossary.zh: 以实际可行结果为重的；务实的
glossary.note: a pragmatic approach/change；不是语言学 pragmatics。
glossary.example: Jay suggested a pragmatic change to the rota.
glossary.exampleZh: 杰伊建议务实地调整排班。

glossary.note: reinforce a habit/belief：巩固习惯／加强信念。
glossary.example: Eli’s complaint reinforced their habit of checking repairs.
glossary.exampleZh: 伊莱的投诉巩固了他们检查维修的习惯。

glossary.zh: 使性质或方式发生显著变化
glossary.note: transform something；变化应较明显，不等同于任何小改动。
glossary.example: The new habit transformed the way Jay finished orders.
glossary.exampleZh: 新习惯彻底改变了杰伊完成订单的方式。

externalEvidence.definition: change or alter in form, appearance, or nature

glossary.zh: 说明某人能力、品行的推荐信
glossary.note: a written testimonial：推荐信；说明某人的能力、品行或工作表现。
glossary.example: The tutor wrote a testimonial about Jay’s repair work.
glossary.exampleZh: 老师为杰伊的维修工作写了推荐信。
